searchText: How does anyone feel about 3.0.0 before Deneb hard fork? Possible items include: - remove deprecated endpoints - remove reward endpoints from experimental section I can open a PR with these changes sounds good, we also need a new release to update our api spec tests. There are also a bunch of other changes on master already that depending on how people are using the spec could be considered breaking, like #399 and #409. I think it's a little early to remove deprecated endpoints. I think there needs to be at least 1 full hard fork where APIs are marked as deprecated before being removed. definitely agree that we can't remove apis like produceBlockV2 yet, there are still users relying on those, even post deneb
